meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 它会调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的具体缺陷，在临时工作区复现、写最小修复并跑通前后验证，再按仓库归属交付：上游 codex 开 fork PR，LazyCodex 缺陷提交内嵌补丁的 issue。
howto.when: 当你要求修复 bug、提交 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR，或调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 的这个 bug，并提交验证过的修复
say.note: 先复现，再交付内嵌补丁的 issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 能复现，帮我提交 fork PR
say.note: 会推到 fork 并向 openai/codex 提 PR。

say.text: 先复现这个缺陷，写个失败的回归测试再修
say.note: 会附上修复前后的验证日志。

howto.what_en: It debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect in a fresh temp workspace, reproduces it, applies the smallest fix and verifies before/after. Upstream codex gets a fork PR; LazyCodex defects get an issue with the patch embedded.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex or Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and file a verified fix
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then opens a patch-embedded issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces; open a fork PR
say_en.note: Pushes a fork branch, then opens the PR upstream.

say_en.text: Reproduce it and write a failing regression test first
say_en.note: Attaches failing and passing verification logs.
